decision_reason: The weighted prompt moved all five anchors toward softness plus some darkening plus glow. Linear combination is a usable first-order control. Residual bloom and invented eye/sun lights show the linear model is incomplete, but not yet enough to require a tensor term. Record pairwise notes and keep the model linear.
entanglement_notes: Softness and bloom still co-occur in the reconstruction.
Shadow density under-expresses relative to its isolated high pole.
next_experiments: Raise only shadow density after a soft reconstruction (sequential, not simultaneous).
Fit weights by comparing reconstruction scores to isolated high poles.
protocol: Translate aesthetic weights into prompt phrases and edit each anchor.
title: Linear reconstruction of aes_soft_halated_shadow
